request.system: Determine whether the proposed hypothesis or expression explicitly avoids a failure described in the report. Return JSON only: {"avoids_failure": true|false|null}. Use null when the evidence is unclear. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary; the value must be a JSON boolean or null, never a quoted string.
request.prompt:
{"report": "**Findings so far**

**Failure:** Ranking groups by three-month change in average hours had no predictive power. Mean rank IC was slightly negative, with t near minus 0.7.

**Promising:** Annual hourly-pay growth, standardized against each group's own five-year history, gave IC about 0.08 with HAC t near 1.8. Coverage was only 44 percent. An expanding-window log-growth version raised coverage to 63 percent. However, it weakened IC to 0.05, with t 1.4.

The pay signal is stronger when the common index is high (IC near 0.2) than when low (about 0.1). A high-regime-only version showed IC 0.19 but no t-statistic, so it is unconfirmed. Signals are persistent and have low correlation with base factors.", "hypothesis": "Proportional three-month shifts in flow mix toward V03 relative to V02, measured in logs, normalize groups with different flow levels. In low-T regimes, groups with larger log shifts earn higher next-month relative returns.", "expression": "regime(lchg(ratio(V03,V02),3),"low")"}
